name: autoflowmate
description: Build safe, reviewable Windows automation (RPA) flows for AutoFlowMate: desktop apps, Tally, Excel, PDFs, Word, e-mail, web pages, OCR, schedules, offline redaction and pseudonymisation. Writes plain JSON flows; validates, dry-runs and runs them when AutoFlowMate is installed.
suggestedPrompts: Make an AutoFlowMate flow that sorts my Downloads folder by file type
Redact PAN and Aadhaar numbers in a folder of PDFs
Export the Tally balance sheet every evening and e-mail it
